cast: Lily (girl, 9), her brother Tom (6), Mum, Dad, Grandma, Grandpa, Lily's classmate Mia, cousin Sam (10) and the puppy Max. Papers, letters, books and tickets; pages show lines or pictures, never readable writing.

words.en: Dad reads an article.
words.scene: Dad reading an article in a newspaper, a big photo on the page.
more: This article is about animals.
这篇文章是关于动物的。
Mum writes an article for school.
妈妈为学校写一篇文章。

words.en: Lily opens a birthday card.
words.sz: Lily 打开一张生日贺卡。
words.scene: Lily opening a birthday card with a big balloon on it.
more: I send a card to Grandma.
我给奶奶寄一张卡片。
Tom draws on a card for Mum.
Tom 给妈妈画一张卡片。

words.en: Tom reads a comic.
more: This comic is very funny.
这本漫画很有趣。
Sam likes the new comic.
Sam 喜欢这本新漫画书。

words.en: Mum fills in a form.
words.scene: Mum filling in a form with a pen.
more: Please write your name on the form.
请在表格上写你的名字。
Dad signs the form now.
爸爸现在在表格上签名。

words.en: Dad has a driving licence.
words.scene: Dad sitting in the driver's seat of the family car, showing a small pink card with his photo on it to Lily in the back seat; the card has no writing.
more: Mum shows her licence.
妈妈出示她的执照。
The police ask for the licence.
警察要看执照。

words.en: Grandpa reads the newspaper.
words.scene: Grandpa reading a big newspaper at breakfast.
more: Dad buys a newspaper every day.
爸爸每天买一份报纸。
The newspaper is on the table.
报纸在桌子上。

words.en: Lily writes in her notebook.
words.scene: Lily writing in a notebook with a flower on the cover.
more: Tom draws in his notebook.
Tom 在他的笔记本上画画。
I put my notebook in my bag.
我把笔记本放进书包里。

words.en: Grandma sends a postcard.
words.scene: a postcard of a beach with a stamp, on a doormat.
more: We buy a postcard at the beach.
我们在海滩买了一张明信片。
The postcard shows the sea.
这张明信片展示了大海。

words.en: Lily reads her textbook.
words.scene: a pile of school textbooks on a desk.
more: Tom takes his textbook home.
Tom 把他的课本带回家。
The textbook has nice pictures.
这本课本有漂亮的图片。

words.en: Look at the big ad.
words.scene: a big colourful poster of a smiling girl with a new bike on a bus stop wall (no writing).
more: Mum sees an ad for shoes.
妈妈看到一个鞋子的广告。
This ad is very funny.
这个广告很有趣。

words.en: Tom watches an advertisement.
words.scene: a TV showing an advertisement for orange juice, Tom watching from the sofa.
more: The advertisement is on the screen.
这个广告在屏幕上。
Mum changes the channel during the advertisement.
妈妈在广告时间换台。

words.en: Dad pays the bill.
words.scene: A grown-up waiter in a white shirt and black apron putting a small folded paper on a little plate in front of Dad at a café table, Dad taking out his wallet.
more: Mum asks for the bill.
妈妈要账单。
The bill is on the table.
账单在桌子上。

words.en: Lily reads a book about horses.
words.sz: Lily 在读一本关于马的书。
more: Please open your book at page ten.
请把书翻到第十页。
Grandpa gives Tom a book of animal stories.
爷爷送给 Tom 一本动物故事书。
senses: Dad books a table for dinner.

words.en: Lily writes in her diary every night.
words.scene: Lily sitting at her desk by the window in the soft afternoon light, writing in a small open book with a pencil, one red ribbon lying beside it; no readable writing on the page.
more: I keep my diary under my bed.
我把日记本藏在床底下。
Grandma reads her old diary.
奶奶读她的旧日记。

words.en: Mum puts her diploma in a box.
words.sz: 妈妈把她的文凭放进盒子里。
more: Sam's uncle has a diploma from college.
Sam 的叔叔有大学文凭。
We celebrate the diploma with a cake.
我们用蛋糕庆祝拿到文凭。

words.en: Dad sends an email to his boss.
words.sz: 爸爸给老板发了一封电子邮件。
words.scene: Mum sitting at her office desk in front of an open laptop, a big empty envelope floating above the screen, no writing anywhere on the screen, a cup beside her hand.
more: Please check your email for news.
请查看电子邮件获取消息。
Lily writes an email to Grandma.
Lily 给奶奶写了一封电子邮件。

words.en: Tom writes a letter to Grandpa.
words.sz: Tom 给爷爷写了一封信。
words.scene: Lily putting a letter in a red post box.
more: The first letter is A.
第一个字母是 A。
Mum opens the blue letter.
妈妈打开了那封蓝色的信。

words.en: Mum reads a magazine in the kitchen.
words.scene: One glossy magazine lying open on a sofa, its cover showing a big photo of a red bird, a cup of tea next to it.
more: This magazine has nice photos.
这本杂志有漂亮的照片。
Dad buys a sports magazine.
爸爸买一本体育杂志。

words.en: The waiter gives us the menu.
more: Lily looks at the menu in the cafe.
Lily 在咖啡馆看菜单。
Dad chooses fish from the menu.
爸爸从菜单上选了鱼。

words.en: Mum leaves a message on the phone.
words.scene: Mum talking on the phone in the kitchen, a big round speech bubble with an empty envelope inside floating beside her head, Tom holding Max by the door.
more: Tom has a message for Lily.
Tom 有给 Lily 的留言。
Can I leave a message here?
我可以在这儿留言吗？

words.en: Lily writes a note for her friend.
words.sz: Lily 给朋友写了一张便条。
more: Dad keeps his notes in a box.
爸爸把笔记放在盒子里。
Please read this short note.
请读这张短便条。

words.en: Mum shows her passport at the airport.
words.sz: 妈妈在机场出示她的护照。
words.scene: Mum holding up a passport (no writing) at the airport
more: Where is Dad's passport?
爸爸的护照在哪儿？
We need passports for the trip.
我们需要护照去旅行。

words.en: Lily works on a school project.
more: Our project is about plants.
我们的项目是关于植物的。
Sam helps with the big project.
Sam 帮忙做大项目。

words.en: Mia sends a text to Lily.
words.sz: Mia 给 Lily 发了一条短信。
words.scene: Mia typing a text on her phone, a heart in the message bubble.
more: Read the text in your book.
读一读你书里的文字。
Dad answers the text quickly.
爸爸很快回复了短信。

words.en: Tom shows his ticket to the man.
more: We buy tickets for the film.
我们买电影票。
Lily keeps her train ticket safe.
Lily 把火车票保管好。
